args.prompt: A tight close-up photograph of a double espresso shot pulling from a polished chrome portafilter into a small ceramic cup, thick hazelnut crema swirling. Hard directional side light from the right, warm late-afternoon amber, deep roasted-brown shadows. Shot on 90mm macro, shallow depth of field, visible film grain, slightly desaturated warm palette of kraft paper beige, roasted bean brown and burnt amber. The left third of the frame is dark, quiet and uncluttered negative space so headline type can sit over it. Silver-halide analog photography, intimate and moody, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no people.
